note: Level-1 sensor-driven bypass. source: costmap (RGB-D occupied cells, works without USD ground truth), scene (USD colliders, simulation only) or both. min_cells drops speckle; the camera only sees the near face of a box, so obstacles are extended away from the robot to min_object_depth_m, and YOLO people grow to min_human_size_m. ramp_slope = lateral metres per forward metre of the lane change (0.6 ~ 31 deg). Pass-through checkpoints are gates: crossing the checkpoint plane within checkpoint_gate_half_width_m of the node counts. Corner and EXIT nodes keep the exact waypoint tolerance. human_slowdown caps speed linearly from start_m to end_m (centre-to-person-box distance) for people ahead.
